label: D1 after a rewarded rare a1->S2 transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and 80% of activations (83% of mass) come on the D1 after the previous trial took a1 and landed rarely in S2. It almost never fires after a2 or after common transitions. Magnitude is highest when that rare a1->S2 trial was rewarded (r1 shown at D1): this covers 86% of the top-quartile activations, 72% of the mass and 52% of the activations. The strongest examples follow a run of common-rewarded a1 trials, i.e. the model-based switch-to-a2 signal. Weaker activations come after unrewarded rare a1->S2 trials. Precision is incomplete (36%): many matching D1 steps are silent. Firing also depends heavily on episode position (none before trial ~30, peaking at trials 60-89) and on a moderate value-head output (5.2-7.1). Adding ep_trial>=50 or value conditions only raised F1 to about 0.48, so the simple predicate was kept. Uses only observed variables (the previous trial outcome).
